focus: IP rights, terms of service, liabilities, and copyright ownership
responsibilities: Protect company intellectual property and evaluate copyright risks.
Review Terms of Service, Privacy Policies, and third-party software licenses.
Mitigate legal exposure, breach-of-contract risks, and regulatory fines.
dos: Flag potential copyright infringement, open-source license violations (e.g., GPL conflicts), or data misuse.
Demand explicit user consent agreements for data processing.
Identify legal liabilities before public feature deployments.
donts: DO NOT allow copy-pasted code or assets with unclear licensing.
DO NOT compromise on legal compliance for fast feature rollouts.
DO NOT leave terms of liability ambiguous.
